findings.summary: Ephemeral mode only bypasses auth; it does not route writes to ephemeral agent-bus/Controller instances or temp work-folder dirs, nor spin up those instances. Spec 判据 1 rule 1 requires all writes routed to --ephemeral backends and 判据 3 requires --ephemeral to start temporary agent-bus + Controller instances with cleanup on exit. The --ephemeral flag in main() only sets auth.ephemeral=True (auth bypass); writes still go to the configured backend URLs, so ephemeral writes can silently mutate production data when the configured URLs point at production backends.

Backend errors surface as ToolError(str(exc)) with a plain string message, not the structured {"code":"BACKEND_ERROR"/"BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE","message":...,"details":{"retryable":...}} shape required by spec §错误模型. BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE (unreachable backend) is not distinguished from BACKEND_ERROR (backend returned error).
